meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 触发 /refactor 后,Claude 会执行一套结构化重构流程:先确认意图和范围(不清楚就问),再分析代码依赖与测试覆盖,规划后逐步修改并每步运行测试,最后全量回归并总结改动。
howto.when: 当用户发出 /refactor 命令,或提到 refactor、cleanup、extract 等触发词时启动。

say.note: Claude 会先分析该文件的影响范围。

say.text: 重构 AuthService 类,拆成独立模块
say.note: Claude 会先确认范围和方案再动手。

say.text: 清理项目里弃用的 API 调用
say.note: Claude 会全局查找并逐处调整。

howto.what_en: Adds a structured refactor workflow: clarify scope (ask if unclear), analyze dependencies/test coverage, plan, change code step by step with checks, then run full regression and summarize.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user runs the /refactor command or mentions trigger words such as refactor, cleanup, extract, etc.

say_en.note: Claude inspects that file's affected scope first.

say_en.text: Refactor the AuthService class into separate modules
say_en.note: Claude confirms scope and approach before starting.

say_en.text: Clean up deprecated API calls across the project
say_en.note: Claude searches globally and adjusts each occurrence.
